reference.note: Last observed successful connection run. Discovery implementation is unchanged in 0.6.16; later changes concern UI and re-stream choices. This is one reference run, not a percentile estimate.

environment.preparation: Use the same host and camera/PTU unit; app listening before cable insertion; adopted secondary addresses removed; retain cached identities; no added network probes. Connect one cable and leave it connected for at least 180 seconds.

clock: Local log timestamps, one-second precision; compare a single connection attempt without wall-clock changes.
invariants: Scan each verified IP as soon as its route is usable; one slow peer must not block another scan.
Adoption must not require open ports; the unidentified peer exposes the PTU subnet.
No fixed sleep after source readiness; retain readiness, identity, conflict and rollback checks.
Primary Host IP first; secondary rows and node identities keep their presentation order; auto tags survive peer presence changes.
update_policy: Keep this baseline fixed when testing later versions. Relaxing limits requires an explained review and fresh comparable evidence; never regenerate limits automatically from a failing run.
